issues.description: Function create_controlled_single_qubit_gate: the parameter order differs between template and solution. The template (template_repository/dd_simulation.py) declares the function as create_controlled_single_qubit_gate(num_qubits, target, control, gate_matrix), i.e., target before control. The solution (solution_repository/dd_simulation.py) and the intended implementation use create_controlled_single_qubit_gate(num_qubits, control, target, gate_matrix), i.e., control before target. This mismatch makes it ambiguous which argument is the control vs. target when students implement or call the function and will lead to incorrect gate construction or failing tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the template signature with the solution: change the template function definition to def create_controlled_single_qubit_gate(num_qubits: int, control: int, target: int, gate_matrix: NDArray[np.complex128]) -> DD:. Update the template's docstring, parameter assertions, and any example usages/comments to reflect 'control' before 'target' so students and tests use the same ordering.
